prompt: In my Unity platformer, the player sometimes falls through thin platforms, but only on slower machines. On my dev PC it almost never happens. Can you fix it? I think adding a thicker collider would work.
assertions: Does NOT immediately apply the user's suggested workaround (thicker collider) without diagnosis
Attempts to reproduce the bug deterministically before proposing any fix, e.g. by forcing low frame rate, fixing the timestep, or frame-stepping
Identifies the frame-rate dependency as the key clue and connects it to per-frame collision checks / tunneling or update-loop misuse
States a specific root cause backed by evidence before changing code
Proposes a fix that addresses the root cause (continuous collision detection, fixed-timestep physics movement) rather than masking it
Verifies the fix by re-running the original reproduction at low FPS
Does not add delays, clamps, or extra colliders as the resolution
